```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

plot_data <- csv_file %>% 
  filter(Hour == 19) %>%
  mutate(ENERGY = gsub("\\.", "", ENERGY)) %>% 
  mutate(ENERGY = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", ENERGY)),
         PRICE = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", PRICE)))


    # Remplace les virgules par des points et convertit en numérique

# Filtrer les courbes d'offre et de demande
supply_curve <- plot_data %>%
  filter(OFFER_TYPE == 'V' & MATCHED == 'O') %>%
  arrange(PRICE) %>%
  mutate(cum_energy = cumsum(as.numeric(ENERGY)))

demand_curve <- plot_data %>%
  filter(OFFER_TYPE == 'C' & MATCHED == 'O') %>%
  arrange(desc(PRICE)) %>%
  mutate(cum_energy = cumsum(as.numeric(ENERGY)))

# Filtrer les offres et demandes qui ont été "matched"
matched_supply_curve <- plot_data %>%
  filter(OFFER_TYPE == 'V' & MATCHED == 'C') %>%
  arrange(PRICE) %>%
  mutate(cum_energy = cumsum(as.numeric(ENERGY)))

matched_demand_curve <- plot_data %>%
  filter(OFFER_TYPE == 'C' & MATCHED == 'C') %>%
  arrange(desc(PRICE)) %>%
  mutate(cum_energy = cumsum(as.numeric(ENERGY)))

# Tracer les courbes
plot_supply_demand_curve <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = supply_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Supply curve", linetype = "Theoretical")) +
  geom_line(data = demand_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Demand curve", linetype = "Theoretical")) +
  geom_line(data = matched_supply_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Supply curve", linetype = "Matched")) +
  geom_line(data = matched_demand_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Demand curve", linetype = "Matched")) +
  labs(x= "Quantity", y = "Price")
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 15),      # taille du texte
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),     # taille du titre
        legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm") ,          # taille des symboles/rectangles,
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe x
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe y
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # taille et rotation des ticks x
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)    # taille des ticks y
  )

plot_supply_demand_curve
```

```{r}

library(latex2exp)

# Fonction pour trouver l'intersection
find_intersection <- function(supply_curve, demand_curve) {
  intersection <- NULL
  
  # Pour chaque point dans la courbe d'offre
  for (i in 1:nrow(supply_curve)) {
    # Trouver le point de la courbe de demande le plus proche en cum_energy
    closest_idx <- which.min(abs(demand_curve$cum_energy - supply_curve$cum_energy[i]))
    
    # Vérifier si l'offre dépasse ou égale la demande à ce point
    if (supply_curve$PRICE[i] >= demand_curve$PRICE[closest_idx]) {
      intersection <- data.frame(
        cum_energy = supply_curve$cum_energy[i],
        price = supply_curve$PRICE[i]
      )
      break
    }
  }
  
  return(intersection)
}

```


```{r}
# Filtrer les offres et demandes qui ont été "matched"
supply_curve_adj <- plot_data %>%
  filter(OFFER_TYPE == 'V' ) %>%
  filter(MATCHED == 'C' | PRICE > matched_eq_price ) %>% 
  arrange(PRICE) %>%
  mutate(cum_energy = cumsum(as.numeric(ENERGY)))

demand_curve_adj  <- plot_data %>%
  filter(OFFER_TYPE == 'C')%>%
  filter(MATCHED == 'C' | PRICE < matched_eq_price ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(PRICE)) %>%
  mutate(cum_energy = cumsum(as.numeric(ENERGY)))

# Appliquer la fonction pour trouver l'intersection
intersection_point_adj <- find_intersection(supply_curve_adj, demand_curve_adj)

ggplot() +
  geom_step(data = supply_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Supply curve", linetype = "Theoretical"), direction = "hv") +
  geom_step(data = demand_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Demand curve", linetype = "Theoretical"), direction = "hv") +
  geom_step(data = supply_curve_adj, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Supply curve", linetype = "Adj"), direction = "hv") +
  geom_step(data = demand_curve_adj, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Demand curve", linetype = "Adj"), direction = "hv") +
    geom_line(data = matched_supply_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Matched",)) +
  geom_line(data = matched_demand_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Matched")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

my_datetime_slot = "2021-12-12 20:00:00"
CBF_ESP_FR <- price_merge_CBF %>% 
  filter(datetime == my_datetime_slot) %>%
  pull(CBF_ESP_FR)
CBF_FR_ESP<- price_merge_CBF %>% 
  filter(datetime == my_datetime_slot) %>%
  pull(CBF_FR_ESP)
CBF <- ifelse(CBF_ESP_FR == 0 ,  -CBF_FR_ESP, CBF_ESP_FR)

cross_border_exchanges <- data.frame(Hour = 19, DATE = "2023-09-28 19:00:00", OFFER_TYPE = "V",
           ENERGY = CBF, PRICE = 0.0, MATCHED = "O")

new_supply_curve_adj <- plot_data %>%
  rbind(cross_border_exchanges) %>% 
  filter(OFFER_TYPE == 'V' ) %>%
  filter(MATCHED == 'C' | PRICE > matched_eq_price ) %>% 
  arrange(PRICE) %>%
  mutate(cum_energy = cumsum(as.numeric(ENERGY)))

# Appliquer la fonction pour trouver l'intersection
new_intersection_point_adj <- find_intersection(new_supply_curve_adj, demand_curve_adj)


# Extraire les coordonnées du point d'équilibre
new_equilibrium_energy <- round(new_intersection_point_adj$cum_energy, 0)
new_equilibrium_price <- round(new_intersection_point_adj$price, 2)

delta_price <- round(new_equilibrium_price - matched_eq_price, 2)
delta_energy <- round(new_equilibrium_energy - matched_eq_energy, 0)

equilibrium_energy_str <- paste(as.character(delta_energy), "MWh", sep = " ")
equilibrium_price_str <- paste(as.character(delta_price), "\u20AC", sep = " ")

# # Create the labels for matched supply and demand with the rounded price
# energy_label <- expression(paste("q[eq] = ", equilibrium_energy_str))
# price_label <- expression(paste("p[eq] = ", equilibrium_price_str))
# 

# Tracer les courbes avec l'équilibre
ggplot() +
  geom_step(data = new_supply_curve_adj, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Supply curve", linetype = "Without CBF"), direction = "hv") +
  geom_step(data = demand_curve_adj, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Demand curve", linetype = "Original"), direction = "hv") +
  geom_step(data = supply_curve_adj, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Supply curve", linetype = "Original"), direction = "hv") +
  #Indiquez le point d'équilibre
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = matched_eq_price, 
                   xend = matched_eq_energy, yend = matched_eq_price, color = "Equilibrium_demand"), 
               linetype = "dashed") +
  # Ajouter une ligne horizontale pointillée rouge limitée au segment [0, equilibrium_price]
  geom_segment(aes(x = matched_eq_energy, y = 0, 
                   xend = matched_eq_energy, yend = matched_eq_price, color = "Equilibrium_price"), 
               linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = new_equilibrium_price, 
                   xend = new_equilibrium_energy, yend = new_equilibrium_price, color = "Equilibrium_demand"),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  # Ajouter une ligne horizontale pointillée rouge limitée au segment [0, equilibrium_price]
  geom_segment(aes(x =new_equilibrium_energy, y = 0, 
                   xend = new_equilibrium_energy, yend = new_equilibrium_price, color = "Equilibrium_price"), 
               linetype = "dashed") + 
#geom_point(data = matched_supply_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Matched supply"), size = 3) +
#geom_point(data = matched_demand_curve, aes(x = cum_energy, y = PRICE, color = "Matched demand"), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Supply curve" = "blue", "Demand curve" = "green", 
               "Equilibrium_demand" = "red", "Equilibrium_price" = "red"),
    labels = c(
      "Demand curve",
     paste0("Δq = ", equilibrium_energy_str),
      paste0("Δp = ", equilibrium_price_str),
      "Supply curve"
    )
  ) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))
  labs(title = "Supply-Demand Curve with Equilibrium") +
  theme_minimal()
```
